column3: The bringing to the ground is attached to the kingdom rather than the fortifications.
“Garden booth” makes the comparison more specific.
“Exiled” is supplied before among the nations.
“Heart” replaces liver, and “to the ground” is not retained.
“Fade away” replaces the pouring out of life.
“Say” replaces testify; “deep” replaces great in the sea comparison.
“We have lived to see it” combines finding and seeing.
“Eyes” renders the daughter of your eye.
“From the first watch” replaces the beginning of the watches.
The order of maidens and young men is reversed.
